headline: Summit Therapeutics and Lunit collaborate on AI pathology research
summary: Summit Therapeutics announced a partnership with medical AI developer Lunit to conduct research in artificial intelligence pathology.
why: Partnerships between clinical biopharma developers and medical AI specialists are accelerating diagnostic precision and oncology development timelines.
